headline: Executive order directing US support for the Global Health Security Agenda, an international effort against infectious disease threats.
what_it_does: This order sets US government policy on the Global Health Security Agenda, an international effort to protect countries from infectious disease threats. Based on its title, it directs how the federal government will work toward this goal. No summary was provided, so the specific duties, programs, or funding it covers are not detailed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on health and foreign affairs
who_it_affects.how: They would likely be directed to carry out or coordinate US work on the Global Health Security Agenda.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 4, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
